courses.name: PRIME (Primary Response in Medical Emergencies, NZ)
courses.audience: Rural health practitioners joining the PRIME emergency response team; NZ medical registration and IV certification required.

audienceEvidence.quote: You must hold a NZ Medical Registration (HPCA 2003) to attend this course and it is recommended that you also hold at least a resuscitation certificate to Level 6, and have had some other experience in emergency medicine.
